title: Mirabel and the Static
author: Cyrus Pemberton
blurb: Felix Marchetti, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
